title: Plinth Stone

steps.prompt: A waist-high square stone pedestal made of three stacked chunky carved stone blocks with a leaf pattern band and a little moss at the base, flat empty top, solid simple shape. A single object alone, centred, whole object in frame with margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no hands, no extra objects. High-end anime fantasy RPG prop art, stylised 3D look with painterly textures, soft cel shading with warm bounce light and cool rim light, carefully designed surface detail, lush bright colours with luminous highlights, only the object described and nothing else on it, original design, no characters, no faces, no photorealism, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 1800 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 1024 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 0.95 m, origin at the centre of the base.
notes: Input image: stylekit/golden/f1/con_prp_plinth_stone.png.
